name: Chuyến đò hòa ước
scene: A small immortal ferry suspended just above a misty river, viewed ALONG ITS DIAGONAL DECK. Two disciples from rival sects, one in indigo and one in ivory, meet at CENTER and exchange a sealed jade box while their elders wait on opposite banks. A tiny golden carp spirit swims through the air below LEFT; slender willow branches at RIGHT. Smoky violet, warm amber, ink blue and ivory. Guarded trust and a fragile new friendship, no giant moon.
